Materials and finish

Specifications and options

What should I measure for an office partition?

Start with the length and height of the partition, the number of openings and where you need privacy or daylight. If the partition includes a glazed entrance, compare aluminum door opening styles before deciding where the frame will sit.

  • Corrosion-resistant aluminum sections.

  • Periodic maintenance and after-sales support.
